caption: Three selected mechanisms answer the same question differently: ER/PR can regulate transcription inside a cell; EGFR receives EGF outside and relays a growth signal inside; PD-1 can dampen signaling in a responding T cell after contact with PD-L1. Receptor shapes, relay dots and molecule counts are schematic. This is a classical ER/PR transcription example and a representative EGFR pair, not an atomic structure, complete pathway or treatment-selection rule.
alt: Three scenes show separate estrogen/ER and progesterone/PR examples beside nuclear DNA and RNA, an EGF-bound EGFR pair crossing a membrane and feeding an internal relay, and PD-L1 on a neighboring cell contacting PD-1 on a T cell with an inhibitory connector to its signaling relay.
scope: Selected classical ER/PR, EGFR and PD-1 mechanism examples, symbolic shapes and counts; no clinical eligibility, benefit, complete-pathway or source-figure claim.
sourceDepth: Primary abstracts and official IUPAC entries, not full research manuscripts/figures.
